observation.visible_scene: A large bonfire of stacked lumber burns in a snow-covered clearing surrounded by dense, snow-dusted pine trees. A rounded rock sits at the left base of the fire, a cut stump at the right, and a thin yellow pole leans in the right background. Bright orange-yellow flames and a pale gray-white smoke column rise from the wood pile throughout.
visible_changes: At the start (t=0.0–0.13s) a person in a gray hooded top, dark trousers and orange hat is positioned left of the fire, legs apart, and moves leftward until they exit the frame by t=0.2s.
From t=0.2s to t=0.47s no person is visible; only the fire burns.
Around t=0.53–0.60s a gloved hand and a long, light-colored wooden plank reappear at the left edge, the plank angled down toward the fire base, then both vanish by t=0.67s.
Across the whole excerpt the flame height and shape continuously flicker (taller plumes at t=0.07, 0.40, 0.73, 1.13, 1.87, 2.40, 2.60s, lower at other times) and the smoke column shifts and thickens.

The wood pile, the flat boards at its left, the snow, the rock, the stump, the yellow pole and the tree line keep the same positions frame to frame, indicating a static camera and no object translation of the fire itself.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the person was doing before t=0.0s and after exiting.
Whether the long plank seen at t=0.53–0.60s was being added to the fire, removed, or merely held, since its end state is not shown.
The full body and actions of the person during the plank moment (only hand and plank enter frame).
Any later change in the fire's size or the wood pile beyond t=2.67s.
uncertain_details: The person's initial posture could be walking or a mid-stride swing; no clear throwing motion is visible.
The plank's interaction with the pile is brief and partly occluded by smoke, so placement vs. withdrawal is not determinable.
Background elements are fixed, but minor camera drift cannot be fully ruled out.
